about: Model verdicts on source against tree for adh (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Diagram 4 is printed between paragraphs 1.22 and 1.23 under Branch discharge pipes, but the tree puts it under the Discharge stacks heading after paragraph 1.30.
findings.evidence: source: "Diagram 4 Branch ventilation pipes" before "Discharge stacks" / tree: "Section 1: Sanitary pipework > Discharge stacks > Branch ventilation pipes"

findings.problem: Diagrams 5 and 6 are printed beside paragraphs 1.31 and 1.32 in the Discharge stacks part, but the tree puts them under Materials for pipes, fittings and joints.
findings.evidence: source: "Diagram 5 Stub stack" above "1.31" / tree: "Section 1: Sanitary pipework > Materials for pipes, fittings and joints > Stub stack"

findings.problem: The two notes printed under Table 7 are attached to Table 6 and are missing from Table 7, whose text stops after its first group heading.
findings.evidence: source (Table 7): "+ Application area code UD should normally be specified" / tree (table-6 text): "+ Application area code UD should normally be specified"; table-7 text ends "Rigid pipes"

findings.problem: The text of Table 6 is mixed line by line with the rows of Table 7 from the next column, though both grids are right.
findings.evidence: tree: "100 1:40 9.2 Ductile iron BS EN 598" and "* Minimum of 1 WC Structure walled"

findings.problem: In the Rodding eye row the cover size is printed only under Circular, but the grid also puts it under Cover sizes Length x width.
findings.evidence: source: "Same size as pipework 1" under Circular (mm) only / tree: "Same size as pipework 1", "Same size as pipework 1"

findings.problem: Diagrams 11 and 12 are printed above the Clearance of blockages heading and belong to the bedding and backfilling text, but the tree puts them under Clearance of blockages.
findings.evidence: source: "Diagram 11 Protection for pipes laid at shallow depths" above "Clearance of blockages" / tree: "Section 2: Foul drainage > Clearance of blockages > Protection for pipes laid at shallow depths (minimum sizes)"

findings.problem: The grid cells of Table 12 drop the note markers, so the link from each value to notes 2 to 7 is kept only in the run-together text.
findings.evidence: source: "750 x 675 7 ... 1000 7 ... 750 x 675 2 ... na 3 ... Manhole shaft 4 ... Steps 5" / tree: "750 x 675", "1000", "na", "Manhole shaft", "Steps"

findings.problem: In Table 14 the second group heading is split, so the end of the heading is read as a material row of its own.
findings.evidence: source: "2. Rodding eyes and access fittings (excluding frames and covers)" / tree: row "(excluding frames and covers)" | "as pipes see Table 7 ETA Certificates"

findings.problem: Paragraph A.3 belongs to Capacity of pipes in the left column but is placed under Traps, after A.4.
findings.evidence: tree: "(see paragraph 1.4) A.4 Minimum trap sizes and seal depths ... Table A3. A.3 Flow rates for other commonly used appliances"

findings.problem: Rows of Table A1 are repeated as a running text block titled Traps, under the Traps heading.
Table A2 Flow rates from appliances sits under the Traps heading, but it is printed under Capacity of pipes.
findings.evidence: tree: "Appendix H1-A: Additional guidance for larger buildings > Traps > Flow rates from appliances"

findings.problem: The title of Table A3 is cut short.
findings.evidence: source: "Minimum trap sizes and seal depths additional to Table 2" / tree: "Minimum trap sizes and seal"

findings.problem: Numbered paragraphs A.1 to A.9 are not kept as separate provisions but merged into one text block per heading, together with the cross-reference line.
findings.evidence: tree: "(see paragraph 1.28) A.1 The flow depends on the type, number and grouping of appliances. A.2 Appliances are seldom in use"

findings.problem: The text of Table A1 holds words from Table A3 and lacks its own rows 10 to 30, and the text of Table A3 lacks its last rows; the grids are right.
findings.evidence: tree (Table A1 text): "(industrial type) 50 75", "Number of Flow rate Urinal stall", "dwellings (litres/sec) (1 to 6 person position) 65 50"

findings.problem: The appendix number is given as H1 instead of H1-A.
findings.evidence: source: "Appendix H1-A" / tree: number "H1"

findings.problem: Diagram 1 has no labels list; the words printed in the picture, including the dimensions, are kept only inside the model description.
findings.evidence: source: "Minimum 2m separation", "50mm", "300mm", "Graded 30–50mm granular material" / tree: text "Drainage field", no labels

findings.problem: The superscript in square metres is flattened in paragraph 1.33.
findings.evidence: source: "a minimum of 1m² in area" / tree: "a minimum of 1m2 in area"

findings.problem: The note printed under Table 2 is attached to Table 1's text, mixed with Table 2's rows, and is absent from Table 2.
findings.evidence: source (under Table 2): "Note: Refers to nominal half round eaves gutters laid level with outlets at one end sharp edged" / tree (Table 1 text): "Pitched roof at 60º plan area of portion x 1.87 Note: Refers to nominal half round eaves gutters"

findings.problem: The closing sentence of paragraph 0.1, which applies to the whole list, is joined to item b.
findings.evidence: source: separate line "The provisions of H3 only apply if these surfaces are paved." / tree: "b. which are yards ... more than one building. The provisions of H3 only apply if these surfaces are paved."

findings.problem: A stray word "Food" from the table is inserted into paragraph 1.2.
findings.evidence: source: "WCs with major flush volumes as low as 4 litres" / tree: "WCs with major flush volumesFood as low as 4 litres"
